Hi Alex —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme is looking to standardize inference across prod and staging, reduce per-token costs, and validate model performance under multi-tenant load. We covered infra constraints (VPC requirement, KMS), expected QPS patterns, and primary success metrics (p95 latency < 300ms and 30% cost reduction).

Next steps we agreed on:
- 45–60 minute technical deep dive (include your Solutions Architect) to walk through infra integrations and a short runbook for compliance evidence.
- Share a mutual action plan and propose demo times that work across your US/EU/APAC stakeholders.

To make scheduling easier given the global stakeholders, I put together a rotating schedule that alternates demo start times each week so it's fair across time zones. Attached: rotating-demo-slots.ics and a short mutual_action_plan.xlsx (first draft). Proposed rotation (examples):

Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10/20 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET
Week B (EU-friendly): Tue 10/27 16:00 CET / 10:00 ET
Week C (APAC-friendly): Tue 11/03 09:00 SGT / Mon 11/02 20:00 ET

If you prefer fewer rotating slots, we can pick two windows and alternate. Please let me know: 1) which week window works best for your team; 2) if Priya (or another SA) should be on the call; 3) any additional agenda items to include.

I can also send a recurring invite that rotates weekly. Quick scheduling link if easier: https://cal.com/aditya-demo/45min
